artifact.note: Sources bound by SHA-256; unrelated uncommitted work from other sessions was present.

implementation.authority: OrganizationAuthority DiscoverLab/DiscoverProject/visibleDatasets/visibleLinks/sharedScopes under the shared policy guard
implementation.cursor: base64url fields: version, principal, directory, query, limit, last key, digest of the caller's matching set

acceptance.criterion: List and search accessible labs/projects/datasets with stable bounded pagination, readable labels and correct empty/error states.
acceptance.evidence: DirectorySuite: labs, projects and datasets per persona; steward labels searchable; limit 1 pages cover both datasets once; limit above 100 refused; empty directory returns total 0; unseen project 404.

acceptance.criterion: Apply authority to names, counts, filters, ordering and suggestions; define live-directory cursor behavior under concurrent membership or catalog changes.
acceptance.evidence: Totals and search count only authorized rows (a hidden dataset's label matches nothing and counts 0); links grant nothing; cursor behavior defined and tested: hidden change leaves the next page byte-identical, visible change gives 409 restart, other principal or query gives 400. No suggestion surface exists (none returned beyond the filtered rows).

acceptance.criterion: Recheck policy on later pages and omit no records silently from a purported frozen result; directory discovery must not expose unauthorized heads or private evidence.
acceptance.evidence: Every page reloads current policy; a changed visible set restarts instead of silently omitting or adding rows. Directory rows carry IDs, labels and status only; shares carry exact scope and label, never project, head, issuer or other recipients (asserted for a fixed R1 share).

limitations: Query-plan qualification is not done: directories filter the fully loaded policy state (H04 scale qualification).
Labels exist only where stewards set them; bootstrap-migrated datasets list with label null until named.
The cursor binds to the caller's matching set, so any visible change in that directory restarts paging, including additions after the current position.
Console navigation using these directories is F05.2 (also blocked by F04.3 identity work).
